thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: elevated 5xx + upstream timeouts observed from gateway -> us-west-2. error rate ~18% over last 3m. alert: gateway.error_rate > 10% for 2m. paging oncall-nyc
oncall-nyc: On it. looking at traces now. any customer-impact notes?
mike-l: seeing a spike in HTTP 502/504s, majority on /v1/generate route. requests with long prompt lengths.
samantha: Confirmed — increased tail latency from model-backend at ~1500ms -> 6s, then gateway timed out. Some errors show "upstream reset" in proxy logs.
lee-k: Can we throttle large requests temporarily? maybe apply a short circuit for requests > 8k tokens.
prod-eng: Suggest quick mitigation: enable short-circuit fallback to smaller model and raise gateway retry budget, AND scale model pool.
oncall-nyc: Trying a soft-failover: set routing policy to fallback-model: gpt-small-quant. Applying now.
infra-bot: runbook action: "apply-fallback-route" invoked by oncall-nyc. cmd: ```redwoodctl route update --svc gateway --fallback model=gpt-small-quant --threshold 0.12```
mike-l: routing change accepted. traffic shifting 20% -> fallback. error rate dropping to 9% in 45s.
samantha: Starting a targeted scale on model pool (us-west-2). kubectl patch deploy model-service -n inference -p '{"spec": {"replicas": 6}}'
lee-k: Increasing gateway timeout from 5s -> 10s as temporary measure: ```kubectl patch deploy gateway -n platform -p '{"spec": {"template": {"spec": {"containers": [{"name":"gateway","env":[{"name":"GATEWAY_TIMEOUT_MS","value":"10000"}]}}]}}}'```
prod-eng: Also flipping circuit-breaker back-off windows to reduce immediate retries: set cb.max_concurrent=120, cb.failure_threshold=0.2
oncall-nyc: After fallback + scale + timeout bump, 5xx down to 3.8%. Good. Customer impact limited to high-latency requests for a few minutes.
ops-lead: Good quick actions. Let's capture next steps and tickets before we close this thread.
mike-l: Hotfix we want: prevent oversized prompts from flooding model pool. Quick PR to validate prompt size at gateway and return 413 for > 12k tokens. I'll open PR now.
samantha: I'll follow up with a canary of new model pool autoscaler params, and add an alert for prompt-length percentile.
prod-eng: I'll create a targeted perf test to reproduce the degraded path (long prompts + concurrent).
infra-bot: Created ticket INF-4921: "gateway: prompt-size hard limit + alerting" by mike-l.
oncall-nyc: Action items: 1) Mike - PR for gateway size check (INF-4921). 2) Samantha - autoscaler tuning + canary (INF-4922). 3) Lee - runbook update for fallback-route and timeout-bump steps (INF-4923). 4) Prod-eng - perf test + report (INF-4924).
ops-lead: Also we should adjust the alert thresholds — current alert triggers on >10% error rate too aggressively for known model maintenance windows. Propose: add suppression window for autoscale windows and add a second alert for sustained >8% for 5m.
mike-l: PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/r/redwood/gateway/pulls/2345 — includes size guard + telemetry to count rejected-over-size.
samantha: Canary autoscaler deploy in progress, pointing at synthetic traffic. Monitoring latency and queue depth.
lee-k: I'll update runbook: add explicit rollback step for fallback-route, commands we executed, and estimated customer impact wording. Put doc under /runbooks/incidents/gateway-timeouts.md
prod-eng: Postmortem outline: timeline, root cause (prompt-length + insufficient autoscaling headroom), mitigations, and follow-ups (infra tickets). I'll draft and link when ready.
ops-lead: Note for oncall rotation: if this reoccurs, escalate to platform SRE and consider temporary token-limit policy for high-volume API keys.
infra-bot: Deploy bot: hotfix gateway PR #2345 merged, CI passed, rolling out canary to 10% traffic.
oncall-nyc: Canary looks good for 6m. No new 5xx. Increasing canary to 50% while autoscaler finishes.
mike-l: Merged and live on 50% canary. Rejected-count metric visible: 32 requests rejected for size in last 10m. Good signal.
samantha: Tuning done, autoscaler policy changed to faster scale-up (scale cooldown 30s -> 10s, target cpu 55% -> 40%).
lee-k: Runbook updated: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/gateway-timeouts (added section: quick rollback commands, detection playbook).
ops-lead: Final checks: bump alert to fire on sustained 8% for 5m, and create a dashboard widget showing prompt-length percentiles.
prod-eng: Draft postmortem created: https://paper.redwood.com/p/gateway-timeouts-draft. I'll add timeline and assign reviewers.
oncall-nyc: Closing ready — monitoring for 1h. If all clear, we'll mark as mitigated.
incident-bot: Incident status changed to: mitigated. severity: P1 -> P3. Closed by oncall-nyc. :white_check_mark:
